_comment: Feedback v1 (docs/feedback_loop_design.md): tap self-reference smoke. counter = 1 + tap(counter) via Sum ramps 1,2,3... each tick reading last tick's value (positional z-1), and settles at 1+8 because the guard clamps the FEEDBACK at 8.
